intro.zh:
我是墨岩，北京电影学院摄影专业2026本科生，专注于图片摄影与短片创作。

在静止的画面与流动的影像之间，我以摄影展开观察与表达。这里呈现我的艺术摄影创作与短片项目，也记录每个项目背后的创作思考。
intro.en:
I am Moyan, working across photography and cinematography.

Through still photographs and moving images, I observe and express. This is a collection of my art photography and short-film projects, alongside the ideas and creative decisions behind them.
